notes: Encodes cleanly as ongoing_effect with two operations: passive emit_light (20ft bright, 20ft dim) and on_caster_spends_action (magic action) attack_roll. Cantrip scaling via threshold_tiers on character axis (1d8/2d8/3d8/4d8 at levels 1/5/11/17). Early-end trigger caster_recasts_spell per SRD text. The 60ft hurl range is unrepresented in OngoingEffect.attack_roll (no attachment field), which is a known surface limitation noted in the dhall comments but not a blocking gap. The scale_die_count scaling node is not emitted for onHit effects inside an attack_roll ongoing operation — the tracer's attack_roll case doesn't call traceDiceAmountScaling — so the scaling appears only in the damage node label. Minor tracer gap, not a surface widening.
